Equal post-audit aggregate work is not a per-step trajectory hash; changed work is recorded rather than described as equivalent speedup.
NPU cooperative-exclusive allocations do not control queue-external users. CPU cores are pinned on a shared host.
Hotspot training peak memory includes a post-timing audit; CPU RSS is process lifetime cumulative.
FP32/BF16 candidate policy here predates later stability changes; current implementation must be qualified separately.
